description: Show an uploaded file, or a Figma project’s frame, with its open comments pinned on it as numbered pins, returned inline as an image, with a legend that ties each number to the comment's id and first line. An image or a frame is shown whole; a PDF one page at a time (default: the first page with open comments); a video as a sheet of the frames its comments are on (up to nine, continue with `from`), or the single frame at `at`. The numbers only label this picture: refer to comments by their id in other tools. Rendering a PDF page or video frames can take a few seconds.

at.description: A video: show the single frame at this moment, in seconds

fileId.description: File id from list_files (or one of its versions), or target.picture.fileId of a comment

from.description: A video: continue the sheet from this second (the last call's view.nextFrom)

page.description: A PDF: the page to show, from 1

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

name: get_file
title: Look at an uploaded file
